args.command: npm ping 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "---"; npm config get registry
which vitest npx npm node; echo "---"; ls -a $(dirname $(which npm))/../lib/node_modules 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat $(which npm) 2>/dev/null | head -20
npm ping; echo "exit=$?"; echo "---"; npm view zod version; echo "exit=$?"
echo $HOME; ls -a $HOME 2>/dev/null; cat $HOME/.npmrc 2>/dev/null; echo "--- global npmrc ---"; npm config list 2>&1 | head -30
ls -a; echo "--- node_modules ---"; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null; echo "--- lock ---"; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -40
find node_modules -type f | head -50; echo "---"; cat node_modules/zod/package.json 2>/dev/null
cat package.json; echo "=== end ==="; ls -la node_modules/zod
